name: Commonroom
description: A civic identity for shared neighborhood spaces. An open-table symbol, dependable blue, and warm paper typography make events and information feel genuinely accessible.
heading: bricolage
rules: Keep the open center of the table mark clear.
Use visible rules to organize notices and event dates.
Information hierarchy takes priority over expressive headline placement.

system.concept: Overlapping civic tickets, a communal-table emblem, bold blue notices, and deeply human editorial type. The information feels public, legible, and worth showing up for.
headline: Come on in.
There is room.
system.productNote: A shared space for different people.
features: A useful neighborhood place for conversation and new connections.
A thoughtful program that welcomes different interests.
A community gets better when more perspectives can be heard.
system.layoutNote: Paper hero with blue noticeboard-like typography and a geometric table image. Events use clear date columns, fine rules, and warm yellow notice backgrounds.
